method: Official purchase routes cross-checked with dated public owner accounts; no purchases, private messages or hands-on tests performed. Facts and quotations were not copied wholesale. Usernames, contact details and private order information are omitted.
coverage_gap: No verified comparable overseas PARDUS owner purchase established in this research; the article explicitly identifies the China-shop report as domestic. Dengfu material is historical ordering context, not a current delivery forecast.
